title: Archive rooms in the app: listed apart, read only, original times
spec: The app agrees to FEATURE_ARCHIVE. SignedInSession::archive(room) gives an archive room's imported times by cursor (None for other rooms); the worker emits Event::Archive (Update::Archive { room, times }) when a room is first seen as an archive and when its times change. The window lists archive rooms under an 'Archive' heading after the active rooms (phone too); an open archive room shows 'Archive: read only' instead of the composer (and in the thread pane), takes no dropped files, shows each imported message's original time (utc_time: 'YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM UTC'), and offers nothing on a message: no selection, reactions, Reply, Edit or Delete, and reaction chips do nothing; threads still open. End to end: a bundle imported into a real server reaches the app as an archive room with both original times, and a post into it is refused.
